# Week 2: Signals and components

**Goal:** Model state with signals and build reusable components with inputs, outputs, model() and content projection.

About 9 hours. Do the steps in order; skip steps marked for the other track.

## 1. Read: [Signals guide: signal, computed, effect, linkedSignal, untracked](https://angular.dev/guide/signals)

- [ ] Done · Both tracks · about 60 min
- Concepts: Signals: signal, computed, effect, linkedSignal, resource

## 2. Read: [Components guide: inputs, outputs, model inputs, content projection](https://angular.dev/guide/components)

- [ ] Done · Both tracks · about 60 min
- Concepts: Components, inputs, outputs, content projection

## 3. Read: [Creating libraries](https://angular.dev/tools/libraries/creating-libraries)

- [ ] Done · Accelerated only · about 30 min
- Concepts: Component libraries

## 4. Watch: [Angular Signals by Deborah Kurata (Pluralsight)](https://www.pluralsight.com/library/courses/angular-signals)

- [ ] Done · Both tracks · about 180 min
- No course licence? Watch the matching topics on the official Angular YouTube channel instead.
- Concepts: Signals: signal, computed, effect, linkedSignal, resource

## 5. Explore in the app: Concepts Lab: Signals

- [ ] Done · Both tracks · about 60 min
- Open in the running app: `http://localhost:4200/lab/signals`
- Files: [`src/app/features/concepts-lab/signals-demo.ts`](../../src/app/features/concepts-lab/signals-demo.ts)
- Look for: computed() caching, effect() with untracked(), linkedSignal() resetting when the course changes, resource() status, reload and abort.
- Concepts: Signals: signal, computed, effect, linkedSignal, resource

## 6. Study the code: The ui-kit library

- [ ] Done · Both tracks · about 60 min
- Open in the running app: `http://localhost:4200/lab/bindings`
- Files: [`projects/ui-kit/src/lib/button/button.ts`](../../projects/ui-kit/src/lib/button/button.ts), [`projects/ui-kit/src/lib/card/card.ts`](../../projects/ui-kit/src/lib/card/card.ts), [`projects/ui-kit/src/lib/paginator/paginator.ts`](../../projects/ui-kit/src/lib/paginator/paginator.ts), [`projects/ui-kit/src/public-api.ts`](../../projects/ui-kit/src/public-api.ts)
- Look for: Attribute selectors on native elements, booleanAttribute, multi-slot <ng-content>, model() for two-way binding, translated labels passed in from the app.
- Concepts: Components, inputs, outputs, content projection, Component libraries
